keyWhy.ko: 핵심은 «매일 밤 학교 주방에서 쿠키가 사라졌다(문제)» 와 «보이지 않는 도둑은 배고픈 다람쥐였고, 꼼꼼한 단서가 사건을 해결했다(해결)» 입니다. 초록색 문장이 정답이에요.
keyWhy.en: The key ideas are the problem (every night, cookies disappeared from the school kitchen) and the solution (the thief was just a hungry squirrel, and careful clues solved the case). The green sentences are the answers.

boxes.a: Minjun the class detective, Mrs. Park the cook, a squirrel
Cookies disappeared from the school kitchen every night.
Minjun followed the clues and found a hungry squirrel.

sumHowto.ko: 먼저 위 세 칸을 보고, 빈칸에 알맞은 단어를 고르세요.
sumHowto.en: Look at the three boxes, then choose the right word for each blank.

words: Minjun, the class detective, decided to solve the mystery.
a person who finds the answers to mysteries

very small pieces of bread or cookies
a small animal with a big fluffy tail
At midnight, something small squeezed through the window.

qs.q: Why did the cookies still disappear after Mrs. Park locked the door?
qs.qko: 박 선생님이 문을 잠갔는데도 왜 쿠키가 계속 사라졌나요?
opts: A squirrel came in through the window.
Someone had a key to the door.
Mrs. Park ate the cookies herself.
evs: The squirrel grabbed a cookie and ran back out the window.
The cook, Mrs. Park, locked the door, but the cookies still vanished.
That night, Minjun hid behind the fridge with a flashlight.
Minjun, the class detective, decided to solve the mystery.
why: 다람쥐는 쿠키를 물고 «창문 밖으로» 달아났어요. 문이 아니라 창문으로 드나들었기 때문에 문을 잠가도 소용없었어요. 열쇠나 박 선생님이 먹었다는 말은 없어요.
The squirrel grabbed a cookie and ran back out the window. It used the window, not the door, so locking the door did not help. Nothing says someone had a key or that Mrs. Park ate them.

qs.q: The story says, "the window was open just a few centimeters." What does "just a few centimeters" mean here?
qs.qko: "the window was open just a few centimeters"라는 말이 있어요. 여기서 "just a few centimeters"는 무슨 뜻인가요?
evs: At midnight, something small squeezed through the window.
Every night, cookies disappeared from the school kitchen.
Mrs. Park laughed and closed the window tightly.
He looked carefully and found three clues.
why: 나중에 «작은 무언가가 창문 틈으로 비집고 들어왔다»라고 나와요. 작은 동물만 겨우 지나갈 만큼 아주 조금 열려 있었다는 뜻이에요.
Later, the story says something small squeezed through the window. The window was open only a tiny bit, just enough for a small animal.

qs.q: Which clues showed that a small animal was the thief?
qs.qko: 어떤 단서들이 작은 동물이 도둑이라는 것을 보여 주었나요?
opts: Crumbs on the windowsill and an acorn shell by the cookie jar.
Big footprints on the kitchen floor.
A note from the thief on the door.
evs: First, there were tiny crumbs on the windowsill.
The cook, Mrs. Park, locked the door, but the cookies still vanished.
Third, there was an acorn shell next to the cookie jar.
"It must be an invisible thief!" the students whispered.
why: 창틀에 작은 부스러기가 있었고, 쿠키 통 옆에 도토리 껍질이 있었어요. 두 단서를 이으면, 도토리를 먹는 작은 동물이 창문으로 드나들었다는 것을 알 수 있어요.
There were tiny crumbs on the windowsill and an acorn shell next to the cookie jar. Put these clues together: a small animal that eats acorns came in through the window.

ends: Minjun builds a snack box with nuts for the squirrel outside.
민준이가 밖에 다람쥐를 위한 견과류 간식 상자를 만들어 줘요.
A Snack Box for the Squirrel
Minjun solves a new mystery about missing lunch boxes.
민준이가 사라진 도시락에 관한 새 사건을 풀어요.

write.src: “It is important to <u>look for clues carefully</u> because <u>they can solve a mystery</u>.”
write.howtoKo: 예문을 틀로 삼아, 빈칸 두 곳을 «중요한 일 + 그 이유» 로 바꿔 영어로 써 보세요.
write.howtoEn: Use the example as a pattern. Write an important thing to do and your reason in English.

chips.b: we can keep our teeth healthy
chips.label: teeth

write.moreKo: 한 걸음 더: «It is important to» 뒤에는 동사(look, check)를 바로 쓰고, «because» 뒤에는 «누가 + 무엇을» 을 쓰세요.
write.moreEn: One more step: after «It is important to», write a verb (look, check). After «because», write who + what.

scenes.1: In a school kitchen in the daytime, a ten-year-old Korean boy with short black hair, round glasses, a blue cap worn backward and a brown vest with many pockets leans close to a windowsill with a magnifying glass and looks at tiny cookie crumbs, while a small acorn shell lies next to a glass cookie jar on the counter.
scenes.3: In the bright school kitchen, a small brown squirrel with a big fluffy tail jumps out of a small open window holding a cookie, while a smiling school cook with a white apron and a white chef's hat laughs with her hands on her cheeks and a ten-year-old Korean boy with short black hair, round glasses, a blue cap worn backward and a brown vest with many pockets grins beside her.
